system.description:
You drive your fist into the stomach of a creature with enough power to lift them off their feet, you then slam them into the ground with massive force.

Make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, on a hit you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + 4d6 and each creature (excluding you and the original target) within 20 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw as you slam the original target into the ground. Affected creatures take 4d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Finisher: The original target must make a Constitution saving throw, being Staggered and Bruised on a failed save.

Monstrous Burst. Creatures within 5 feet of you when you cast this jutsu makes their saving throws at disadvantage.

Healers Touch. Allied creatures within range are unaffected by the shockwave, and instead gain temporary hit points equal to half of the damage area of effect damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6.
